'''Nol Ilen''' was a young [[Near-Human]] [[Unidentified wavy-eared species|alien]] individual who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demar]]. He joined [[Lant Mining Corporation]] at the age of eighteen, and worked as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] on [[Lish V]].
